name: Architecture — Direct Policy or Solution
sql:
with classification(atom_id, proposed_form, reason, confidence) as (
  values
    ('CA-M-432','Solution','Selects one PROGRAMMATIC runtime architecture: modular monolith with shared queue and run state.','High')
    ,('CA-M-403','Direct Policy','Shared rule: adapters reuse the canonical behavioral owner.','High')
    ,('CA-M-411','Direct Policy','Shared cohesion preference for every implemented R/D claim; no selected runtime structure.','High')
    ,('CA-E-644','Direct Policy','Acceptance rules for canonical ownership and declared behavior across implementation changes.','High')
    ,('CA-M-407','Direct Policy','Shared construction rule: deterministic transformations go in functions.','High')
    ,('CA-M-408','Direct Policy','Shared construction rule: owned state, lifecycle and resources belong to objects.','High')
    ,('CA-M-425','Direct Policy','Shared separation rule for deterministic decisions and effect owners.','High')
    ,('CA-M-426','Direct Policy','Shared computation/effect/recording boundary; overlap with M425 needs content review.','Medium-high')
    ,('CA-E-648','Direct Policy','Acceptance rules for computation, effect and business-recording boundaries.','High')
    ,('CA-M-413','Direct Policy','Shared rule for typed replaceable-boundary contracts.','High')
    ,('CA-M-418','Direct Policy','Shared rule preserving declared interface compatibility.','High')
    ,('CA-E-650','Direct Policy','Recurring acceptance rules for every active native Tool; its specific frontier scope merits a later boundary check.','Provisional')
    ,('CA-M-471','Direct Policy','Parity rule applies to every current and future Workbench backend capability; no concrete adapter topology is chosen.','High')
)
SELECT
  a.reference as atom_id
  ,coalesce(a."header.state.version", a."header.version") as version
  ,coalesce(a."header.context.role", a."header.role", a."header.content_role") as role
  ,coalesce(a."header.context.form", a."header.form", a."header.type") as current_form
  ,c.proposed_form
  ,c.confidence
  ,c.reason
  ,split_part(a."content.summary", chr(10), 1) as summary
  ,coalesce(a."content.claim.prose_claim", a."content.summary") as policy_content
  ,a."content.claim.formal_claim"
  ,a."content.semantics"
  ,a."content.details"
from atoms as a
join classification as c on c.atom_id = a.reference
where true
  and a.status_group = 'Current'
order by
  case when c.proposed_form = 'Solution' then 0 else 1 end
  ,a.reference
;

name: M E D — Form and merge review
sql:
with review(atom_id, action, proposed_form, merge_target, reason, review_status) as (
  values
    ('CA-M-284','Merge and reform','Solution','CA-M-284','Merge M417 into the shared Settings Reader contribution.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-417','Merge into M284','Solution','CA-M-284','Repeats the same shared reader and immutable configuration snapshot.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-432','Change Form','Solution','','Selects one modular PROGRAMMATIC runtime with shared queue and run state.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-425','Merge M426','Direct Policy','CA-M-425','One computation/effect boundary policy; preserve distinct Run and recording clauses.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-426','Merge into M425','Direct Policy','CA-M-425','Repeats the deterministic-core and explicit-effect-owner rule.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-423','Keep; deduplicate references','Direct Policy','','Keep isolated Python execution invariant; share its wording from one owner.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-429','Trim repeated text','Direct Policy','','Keep uv workflow responsibilities; reuse M423 isolated-execution rule.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-414','Trim repeated text','Direct Policy','','Docker rotation/buffer values occur twice; retain one complete statement.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-M-412','Keep','Direct Policy','','Inherited Python platform/configuration rule; a version literal alone does not require a Decision.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-M-415','Keep','Direct Policy','','Operator requires Python policy to apply automatically to future applicable Apps.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-M-427','Keep','Direct Policy','','Mypy is an inherited toolchain policy, not automatically a local Decision.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-M-428','Keep','Direct Policy','','Ruff is an inherited toolchain policy, not automatically a local Decision.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-M-430','Keep','Direct Policy','','Pydantic boundary validation is an inherited conditional policy.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-M-505','Keep','Direct Policy','','Operator explicitly required all hot reload to be switchable and disabled by default.','Reviewed')
    ,('CA-E-650','Review Form','Solution','','Specific installed native Tool-frontier acceptance; Operator choice pending.','Needs decision')
    ,('CA-E-536','Merge E638','Direct Policy','CA-E-536','Own complete canary admission, including bounded exposure, stop and tested rollback.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-E-638','Merge into E536','Direct Policy','CA-E-536','Same Scope; entire Claim is a subset already present in E536. Preserve safety qualifier; repair M424 reference.','Candidate')
    ,('CA-D-638','Keep','Direct Policy','','Generic manifest/reproducibility requirements for every delivered bundle; no fixed local carrier design.','Reviewed')
)
SELECT
  coalesce(a."header.context.role", a."header.role", a."header.content_role") as role
  ,a.reference as atom_id
  ,coalesce(a."header.state.version", a."header.version") as version
  ,coalesce(a."header.context.form", a."header.form", a."header.type") as current_form
  ,coalesce(r.action, 'Keep') as action
  ,coalesce(r.proposed_form, 'Direct Policy') as proposed_form
  ,r.merge_target
  ,coalesce(r.review_status, 'Reviewed — no change proposed') as review_status
  ,coalesce(r.reason, 'Distinct inherited contribution; no supported merge or Form change in this pass.') as reason
  ,split_part(a."content.summary", chr(10), 1) as summary
  ,coalesce(a."header.context.topics.main_subject", cast(a."header.topics.main_subject" as varchar), a."header.subjects.active", cast(a."header.subjects.governs" as varchar)) as current_subject
  ,coalesce(a."content.claim.prose_claim", a."content.summary") as policy_content
  ,a."content.claim.formal_claim"
  ,a."content.details"
from atoms as a
left join review as r on r.atom_id = a.reference
where true
  and a.status_group = 'Current'
  and a.reference in ('CA-D-638', 'CA-E-389', 'CA-E-536', 'CA-E-539', 'CA-E-540', 'CA-E-637', 'CA-E-638', 'CA-E-639', 'CA-E-642', 'CA-E-643', 'CA-E-644', 'CA-E-645', 'CA-E-646', 'CA-E-647', 'CA-E-648', 'CA-E-649', 'CA-E-650', 'CA-E-651', 'CA-E-797', 'CA-M-191', 'CA-M-284', 'CA-M-395', 'CA-M-396', 'CA-M-397', 'CA-M-398', 'CA-M-399', 'CA-M-400', 'CA-M-402', 'CA-M-403', 'CA-M-404', 'CA-M-405', 'CA-M-406', 'CA-M-407', 'CA-M-408', 'CA-M-409', 'CA-M-410', 'CA-M-411', 'CA-M-412', 'CA-M-413', 'CA-M-414', 'CA-M-415', 'CA-M-416', 'CA-M-417', 'CA-M-418', 'CA-M-419', 'CA-M-420', 'CA-M-421', 'CA-M-422', 'CA-M-423', 'CA-M-424', 'CA-M-425', 'CA-M-426', 'CA-M-427', 'CA-M-428', 'CA-M-429', 'CA-M-430', 'CA-M-431', 'CA-M-432', 'CA-M-471', 'CA-M-501', 'CA-M-505')
order by
  case coalesce(a."header.context.role", a."header.role", a."header.content_role") when 'Method' then 0 when 'Evaluation' then 1 else 2 end
  ,case when r.action in ('Change Form', 'Merge and reform', 'Merge M426', 'Merge E638', 'Review Form') then 0 else 1 end

name: Engineering topics — applied main Subjects and dependencies
sql:
with topic_properties as (
  SELECT
    a.reference
    ,p.field
    ,p.topic_values
  from atoms as a
  cross join lateral (
    values
      ('main_subject', coalesce(to_json(a."header.context.topics.main_subject"), a."header.topics.main_subject", to_json(a."header.subjects.active"), a."header.subjects.governs"))
      ,('dependencies', coalesce(a."header.context.topics.dependencies", a."header.topics.dependencies", a."header.subjects.passive", a."header.subjects.depends_on"))
  ) as p(field, topic_values)
  where true
    and a.status_group = 'Current'
)
,topic_strings as (
  SELECT
    p.reference
    ,p.field
    ,json_extract_string(j.value, '$') as topic
  from topic_properties as p
  ,json_tree(p.topic_values) as j
  where true
    and j.type = 'VARCHAR'
)
,engineering as (
  SELECT
    reference
    ,field
    ,trim(replace(regexp_replace(topic, '^.*?(/Aspect/Engineering|/Engineering/Aspect|Aspects?\s*<\+\s*Engineering)(/|\s*<\+\s*)?', 'Engineering/'), ' <+ ', '/'), '/') as topic
  from topic_strings
  where true
    and regexp_matches(topic, '(/Aspect/Engineering|/Engineering/Aspect|Aspects?\s*<\+\s*Engineering)($|/|\s*<\+)')
)
SELECT
  topic
  ,count(distinct reference) as atoms
  ,count(*) filter (where field = 'main_subject') as main_subject_references
  ,count(*) filter (where field = 'dependencies') as dependency_references
from engineering
group by 1
order by 1
;
